title: Qwen-ADM cohort map (n=4,500)
description: Two scatter panels show mean cosine similarity to the reference answer and population variance across four candidate responses for a fixed cohort of 4,500 instructions. The left panel shows the full measured range; the right panel enlarges the variability range from 0 to 0.03.
claim_boundary: This cohort map is defined by the Qwen reference answer; it does not establish equivalence to a GPT-4o-defined map or exact reproduction of the original paper's map.
regeneration_note: The public spec preserves the measured domains, boundaries, counts, layout contract, and source digest. Re-rendering individual points requires the frozen source rows matching source_sha256.
